items.heading: Palusami Samoan
details: Key ingredients: taro leaves, coconut cream, onion
Layer taro leaves with chopped onion.
Pour coconut cream generously over the leaves.
Wrap tightly and bake or steam until tender.
Serve warm alongside baked taro or breadfruit.

items.heading: Oka i'a
details: Key ingredients: raw fish, coconut cream, lime, vegetables
Cure diced raw fish in fresh lime juice.
Drain and mix in coconut cream.
Add diced cucumber, tomato and onion.
Chill briefly and serve cold.
